The server gives any MCP client (claude.ai, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode…) the phone\'s tools: commands through the chosen backend (root/ADB/Termux) and file read/write. Every risky action is confirmed on the phone.
Local address (for agents on this phone):\n%1$s
claude.ai in a browser needs a public address

claude.ai calls the connector from Anthropic's servers, so a tunnel is required. Run in the terminal:

pkg install cloudflared
cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:%1$d

It prints an address like https://….trycloudflare.com. In claude.ai open Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector and enter that address followed by %2$s. The address contains a secret — do not share it.

Open in profile (long press to rename)

Connect external agents under your own accounts. Sign-in happens on the service\'s own site (email, Google, etc.) in the built-in browser. Every account has its own browser profile and data folder, so you can keep several accounts of one agent.
